deities: Lord Shiva as Mallikarjuna (presiding, in the sanctum)

history.dynasty: Badami (Early) Chalukya; commissioned by Queen Trailokyamahadevi, consort of Vikramaditya II
history.period: Mid-8th century CE (c. 745 CE); part of the UNESCO World Heritage Group of Monuments at Pattadakal (inscribed 1987)
history.summary: The Mallikarjuna Temple was built c. 745 CE by Queen Trailokyamahadevi (Trilokamahadevi), the second queen of Chalukya king Vikramaditya II, to commemorate his victory over the Pallavas of Kanchi. It stands beside the larger Virupaksha Temple, built by queen Lokamahadevi for the same victory. A fully developed Dravidian-vimana Shiva temple, it is one of nine temples in the Pattadakal complex, the Chalukyas' coronation site (Pattadakisuvolal), and is maintained by the Archaeological Survey of India. Coordinates are for the Pattadakal monument complex (temple-level precision approximate). CSV NOTE: the CSV's 'state' column wrongly holds the town name 'Pattadakal' — the temple is in the state of Karnataka.

name: Mallikarjuna Temple
town_description: Pattadakal is a small town in Bagalkot district on the banks of the Malaprabha river. It was the coronation site of the Early Chalukya kings and today is a UNESCO World Heritage site, usually visited together with Badami (approx. 22 km) and Aihole (approx. 11 km) as the classic Chalukyan circuit of north Karnataka.

travel.airport: Hubballi Airport (HBX), approx. 130-150 km; the nearest major rail/air hub. Belagavi and Kalaburagi are other options.
travel.railway: Badami railway station, approx. 22 km; Hubballi Junction is the major railhead for the region.
travel.road: 22 km from Badami and 11 km from Aihole by road; autos, taxis and buses run from Badami. The compact monument complex is covered on foot in 2-3 hours.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March. Mornings are cooler and better for photography of the stone carvings.
visitor_information.opening_hours: The ASI monument complex is open daily approx. 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM; entry fee applies (verify current hours and fees before visiting).
